description: REGEXP_SUBSTR_ALL(subject, pattern [, position [, occurrence [, parameters [, group_num]]]]) returns a VARIANT ARRAY of all matches, or of the named capture group from each match, with an empty array when nothing matches and NULL for a NULL argument. REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL is an exact alias. Converted 1:1 from functions/RegexpSubstrAllTest (now retired); the ARRAY results are read through TO_JSON so the assertion lands on a VARCHAR no transport reformats.
